technical_and_design_decisions: Baseline on Java 17 with Spring Framework 6 / Spring Boot 3, consistent with the specification's statement that Spring Framework 6.0 requires Java 17+.

U1: Implement Azure Event Hubs support as a Spring Cloud Stream binder (producer/consumer factories, provisioning, error handling) built on the official Azure SDK for Java (azure-messaging-eventhubs), plus prebuilt source and sink modules exposing configuration via @ConfigurationProperties.

U2: Integrate with IPython/Jupyter notebooks through the notebook's REST and WebSocket kernel protocol to push/pull stream data, rather than embedding a JVM-based kernel; provide sample notebooks demonstrating real-time computations on XD streams.

U3: Adopt a side-by-side, non-destructive installation/upgrade layout that never overwrites existing install directories or files, and provide a migration utility/script that copies and adapts the previous servers.yml for the new release.

U4: Implement a local/direct binder in Spring Cloud Stream that binds module output/input channels in-JVM via Spring Integration DirectChannel handoff, honoring the existing Binder SPI (including partitioning keys) so no messaging middleware is required.

U5: Build the REST API foundation with Spring MVC/Spring Data REST controllers and HATEOAS representations over a repository SPI, exposing CRUD endpoints for stream definitions and batch job definitions on the admin (xd-admin) server.
U6: Define a ModuleRegistry interface and provide a lightweight stub/in-memory implementation intended for creating mock streams in tests.

U7: Perform a git history-preserving move of spring-cloud-stream-modules into the spring-cloud-stream repository, keeping Maven coordinates stable, and update parent POMs, build plans, and cross-references.

U8: Implement the in-memory stream definition repository as a ConcurrentHashMap-backed implementation of the StreamDefinitionRepository SPI, explicitly non-persistent, selectable via configuration for development use.
Use JUnit 5 for unit tests across all stories, with integration tests per story (Testcontainers or live services where applicable); keep changes backward compatible with existing public APIs.
assumptions: A single developer performs all work; estimates are effort in workdays (1 workday = 8 focused hours), not elapsed calendar time, and exclude waiting time such as external review turnaround.

The existing Spring XD, Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s), and Spring Cloud Data (s-c-d) codebases are available, buildable, and familiar to the developer; the estimate covers only the increment described by U1-U8.
An Azure subscription with an Event Hubs namespace is available for developing and running U1 integration tests.
's-c-s' means Spring Cloud Stream and 's-c-d'/'spring-cloud-data' means Spring Cloud Data (Flow); 'modules' refers to stream source/processor/sink modules.
The IPython integration targets the standard IPython/Jupyter notebook via its REST/WebSocket kernel protocol; no custom kernel or notebook UI development is included.
U3 is limited to preserving prior installation directories/files and enabling copy/reuse of servers.yml; automated migration of persisted runtime data is out of scope.
U5 covers server-side REST APIs only; no web UI/client application work is included.
Documentation effort means developer-facing reference docs, README updates, and migration notes, not full user guides or marketing material.
Each implementation activity includes its unit tests; dedicated integration/system testing and release activities are estimated separately.

activities.activity_name: Increment requirements analysis and architecture design
activities.activity_description: Analyze U1-U8, confirm scope against existing Spring XD/s-c-s/s-c-d codebases, produce the overall design (binder SPI usage, REST API structure, repository SPIs, upgrade layout) and the WBS used for delivery.

activities.activity_name: Build and CI environment preparation
activities.activity_description: Set up/update Maven builds, CI plans, and test infrastructure (including Azure credentials handling) needed for the new modules in this increment.

activities.activity_name: U1: Azure Event Hubs binder core implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement the Spring Cloud Stream binder for Azure Event Hubs using the Azure SDK: connection/consumer/producer factories, provisioning, checkpointing/error handling, and configuration properties.

activities.activity_name: U1: Event Hubs source and sink modules
activities.activity_description: Create prebuilt Event Hubs source and sink modules with configuration properties and enable auto-configuration so XD/s-c-s users can read/write Event Hubs data.

activities.activity_name: U1: Event Hubs testing and documentation
activities.activity_description: Unit tests plus integration tests against a live Event Hubs namespace; reference documentation for binder and module options.

activities.activity_name: U2: IPython Notebook integration design and prototype
activities.activity_description: Design the interaction between Spring XD streams and the IPython/Jupyter kernel (REST/WebSocket protocol), and build a working prototype pushing live stream data into a notebook.

activities.activity_name: U2: IPython integration implementation and examples
activities.activity_description: Implement the integration support code and configuration, plus sample notebooks demonstrating interactive real-time computations on XD stream data.

activities.activity_name: U2: IPython integration tests and documentation
activities.activity_description: Automated tests for the integration endpoints/handlers and user-facing documentation with setup instructions.

activities.activity_name: U3: Non-destructive upgrade and config reuse implementation
activities.activity_description: Change installation/packaging to a side-by-side layout that preserves older install dirs/files, and implement the utility that copies/adapts the previous servers.yml into the new installation.

activities.activity_name: U3: Upgrade tests and migration guide
activities.activity_description: Test upgrade scenarios from the previous release (config reuse, preserved files) and write the upgrade/migration guide.

activities.activity_name: U4: Direct (local) binder implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement the in-JVM direct binder in Spring Cloud Stream using DirectChannel handoff via the Binder SPI, with partitioning support, enabling middleware-free, low-latency module binding.

activities.activity_name: U4: Direct binder tests and documentation
activities.activity_description: Unit/integration tests (including throughput sanity checks and partition routing) and documentation of direct-binding usage and limitations.

activities.activity_name: U5: Admin domain model and repository SPIs
activities.activity_description: Define the domain model and repository service-provider interfaces for stream definitions and batch job definitions backing the xd-admin REST layer.

activities.activity_name: U5: Stream CRUD REST controllers
activities.activity_description: Implement HATEOAS-based REST controllers for creating, reading, updating, deleting, and listing stream definitions (including validation and error handling).

activities.activity_name: U5: Batch job CRUD REST controllers and admin wiring
activities.activity_description: Implement REST endpoints for batch job definition CRUD and wire all controllers into the xd-admin application configuration.

activities.activity_name: U5: REST API tests and documentation
activities.activity_description: MockMvc/integration tests for all new endpoints and API reference documentation.

activities.activity_name: U6: ModuleRegistry interface and stub implementation
activities.activity_description: Define the ModuleRegistry API and an in-memory stub implementation, plus tests demonstrating creation of mock streams through the registry APIs.

activities.activity_name: U7: Move spring-cloud-stream-modules into the s-c repository
activities.activity_description: Perform a history-preserving move of the modules project, update parent POMs and module lists, keep artifact coordinates stable, update CI plans and fix all cross-project references.

activities.activity_name: U8: In-memory stream definition repository
activities.activity_description: Implement a ConcurrentHashMap-backed StreamDefinitionRepository, make it selectable via configuration for development, and add unit tests and brief docs.

activities.activity_name: End-to-end integration testing and defect fixing
activities.activity_description: Cross-story system testing (REST API + registry + repositories + direct binding + Event Hubs modules), regression testing against existing XD/s-c-s behavior, and fixing defects found.

activities.activity_name: Release packaging, release notes, and final documentation
activities.activity_description: Assemble the distribution, verify the upgraded installation flow, finalize reference docs, and write release notes covering U1-U8.
